fields.name: pos
fields.note: field8: read / write add the count, seek sets it (sub_102BF0 copies the quadword to the result)

fields.name: state
fields.note: field8: 1 after the close (sub_102A70), 3 after a read

fields.name: fd
fields.note: field8: the pfs0 descriptor every callback passes to sce*

fields.name: go
fields.note: field8: H_ResrcMan_Update sets 1 with the request; the worker clears it before sleeping

fields.name: request
fields.note: field8: the request the worker serves (ResmanRequest)

fields.name: file_name
fields.note: field8: char[]; empty = no file (H_Cdvd_Request(name, archive))

fields.name: state
fields.note: field8: 0 new, 1 loading, 2 with the worker, 3 done

fields.name: cdvd_node
fields.note: field8: destroyed by the worker after the load

fields.name: frames_waited
fields.note: field8: H_ResrcMan_Update counts the frames in state 2
